title: Writing a work report
body:
A work report (TR) states, in this order:

1. What you changed — one paragraph per instructed item, describing the behaviour that actually changed.
2. Why — which design decision you followed, and the reason for any deviation.
3. How you verified it — the test commands you ran and their results. If you could not run them, say so.
4. What is left — the scope you did not cover and why.
5. The changed-files section — its format is in the submit/changed_files help leaf.

Do not hand verification back to the user. Reproduce, fix and measure before submitting.

Record test code, fixtures, mocks and bounded self-check results. TS/TSR handles the formal gate.
